tool.name: Webatlas Build config
tool.command: ln -s "$input_img_metadata_1" input_img_metadata_1.json && /usr/local/bin/build_config.py #if $project: --project '$project' #end if #if $dataset: --dataset '$dataset' #end if --file_paths "[ #for $file in $input_zarr: '$file.extra_files_path/$file.metadata.store_root/', #end for ]" ## TODO: implement --images : dict[str, list[dict[str, T.Any]]] --images "{ 'label': [{ 'path': '$input_img_1.extra_files_path/$input_img_1.metadata.store_root/', 'md': '$input_img_metadata_1' }] }" #if $url: --url '$url' #end if ## TODO: implement options : dict[str, T.Any] #if $layout: --layout '$layout' #end if #if $custom_layout: --custom_layout '$custom_layout' #end if #if $title: --title '$title' #end if #if $config_filename_suffix: --config_filename_suffix '$config_filename_suffix' #end if && mv $project-$dataset-'$config_filename_suffix'* $output_json

param.label: Zarr file(s) generated by 'Webatlas Process files'

param.label: url
param.help: URL to prepend to each file in the config file. The URL to the local or remote server that will serve the files.

param.label: Layout

param.name: custom_layout
param.label: Custom layout
param.help: String defining a Vitessce layout following its alternative syntax. https://vitessce.github.io/vitessce-python/api_config.html#vitessce.config.VitessceConfig.layout https://github.com/vitessce/vitessce-python/blob/1e100e4f3f6b2389a899552dffe90716ffafc6d5/vitessce/config.py#L855

param.name: title
param.label: Title
param.help: Data title to show in the visualization.
